content: Safety-critical triage systems that over-alert train operators to distrust and dismiss (alert fatigue) -- one SOC example: 85% false positive rate caused analysts to miss ~12% of critical threats despite heavy alerting. Lesson for hazard detection: high recall at the cost of precision is correct for genuinely rare, catastrophic misses (a missed P1 hazard), but if the false-positive rate is too high the human triage queue becomes desensitized and starts rubber-stamping AI escalations without real scrutiny. Explainability (evidence field, confidence display) is critical to sustaining human trust in AI escalations over time.
